# AE Factory Sales

> Houston manufacturer and installer of patio enclosures: polycarbonate 3-season rooms (Clearfixed, Clearfold), Hexfold retractable honeycomb aluminum screens, Fixed Screen 304 stainless steel screens, and the Hybrid (polycarbonate plus mesh). Built in our own factory at 2605 William Tell Street, Houston, TX, and installed by our own crew within a month of order. Sales and showroom: 2609 William Tell Street, Houston, TX 77093. Phone (713) 791-8073. info@aefactorysales.com. Serving Houston and the greater Houston area since 2022.

Key facts (as of November 2026):
- Lowest installed prices per sq ft of opening: Fixed Screen $24, Hexfold $28, Clearfixed $31, Clearfold $40, Hybrid $56. Priced by open wall area filled, not floor area.
- Example: a 16 × 14 ft covered patio with two open sides (about 240 sq ft of openings) runs about $5,800 to $6,700 in metal screens or $7,400 to $9,600 as a polycarbonate 3-season room.
- Warranty: lifetime on the frame, 3 years on parts, installed and maintained by the manufacturer; excludes accidents, intentional damage and acts of God.
- Hexfold: honeycomb aluminum mesh (about 115 holes per sq in), stainless steel wheels, opens by hand with no motor; up to 10 × 10 ft per pull or 20 ft wide meeting in the middle; operates in winds to about 40 mph, 100+ mph when retracted and secured.
- Fixed Screen: 304 stainless steel mesh,  panels up to 3.5 × 10 ft, arches available, pet doors available.
- Polycarbonate panels: Midnight Smoke (black) or Storm Blue tint; Midnight Smoke tested at 48% visible light transmission and 0.45 SHGC; fixed panels rated to 100 mph. Sold as a ventilated 3-season room, not air-conditioned.
- Frames (all systems): heat welded, no screws; PVC and fiber blend with an aluminum rod core and scratch-resistant ceramic coating; Night Gray or Bright White.
- Hours: showroom by appointment only; appointments available 24 hours.
- Built for existing roofed patios. Free site visit and quote.
